name: Believing Lies
overview: Scripture warns against trusting in deceitful and lying words, highlighting the destructive power of falsehoods spoken by the wicked. The Psalms reveal that lying is rooted in pride and is used as a weapon against the righteous, while Jeremiah emphasizes that those who speak lies do not know God and move from evil to evil. Instead, believers are called to place their full trust in the Lord rather than relying on their own understanding or on words that cannot profit. God sovereignly creates both the instruments of labor and destruction, underscoring His control even over those who propagate lies.
